text: Valarjar Stormriders are vrykul found riding Storm Drakes at the High Gate in the Halls of Valor dungeon. While alive, they are untargetable, but their corpses are seen after killing the Storm Drakes. One was killed by Vyranoth when she came to free storm dragons.

Valorstones are used alongside seasonal crests to upgrade gear of all types from The War Within seasons. Valorstones come from looting outdoor treasures, quests, weekly events, dungeons, raids, and PvP. Valorstones were reset to 0 in Season 2, but not in Season 3. All quality colors used in this article line up with the six upgrade tracks, as shown in the Upgrade tracks table, rather than the normal item quality.

Veiled Blessing has a chance to drop from a Heavy Trunk or Bountiful Heavy Trunk, after reaching rank 1 of the Delver's Journey during Midnight Season 1. The buff lasts for 24 hours or until the next delve is completed. It does not display the buff in its tooltip. The buff provided will knock back surrounding enemies when the player gets hit in melee range. It can only occur every 1 min.

Practitioners of this diet are known as "vegetarians". In addition to dietary restrictions, some vegetarians also refuse to wear clothes made of animal parts such as leather and fur. The D.E.H.T.A., an organization of druids for the ethical and humane treatment of animals, produces clothing from artificial substitutes such as Faux Leather Hood. The Vengeful Wisp is a wisp found in the Irontree Woods in . Druids can speak to it to get it to follow them; killing satyr at Jadefire Run alongside the wisp will eventually grant the buff. Speaking to the Vengeful Wisp with this buff will cause it to drop Gift of the Wisp on the ground, which contains the Rune of the World Tree.
